title: Resume — Michael C.
description: Hands-on Java backend engineer with 13 years of experience, including Alibaba Group and DiDi, followed by wallet and payment systems at Huobi and dtcpay.
name: Michael C.
tagline: Java Backend Engineer · Payments & Wallets · Distributed Systems

sections.heading: SUMMARY
paragraphs: Hands-on Java backend engineer with 13 years of experience, including Alibaba Group and DiDi, followed by wallet and payment systems at Huobi and dtcpay.

For the past 4 years I've owned backend modules for wallets and payments: a non-custodial multi-chain wallet at Huobi and a consumer e-wallet at dtcpay in Singapore. My focus is transaction integrity, reliability, and recovery from failures.
I take a module from design to production on my own and work well in async, remote teams across time zones.

pairs.text: requirements and decisions live in docs; async by default, meetings short and purposeful.
judged by working results and data; focused on solving problems.
code review, clear standards, clear ownership.
use measurements, production observations, and technical trade-offs to resolve disagreements.
document decisions, share context, and raise issues directly and respectfully.
thread pools, JVM OOM troubleshooting, transaction pitfalls
index design, cursor pagination, conditional updates + row locks
caching, distributed locks, Bloom filters
reliable delivery, idempotent consumers
idempotency, state machines, channel integration, reconciliation
wallet creation, transaction broadcast, block scanning, reorg handling

jobs.role: Senior Java Backend Engineer — E-Wallet Owner
jobs.context: Singapore-based digital payments company | Apr 2024 – Present | Singapore
jobs.intro: MAS-licensed payment institution (fiat + stablecoin). Owned the core flow of the consumer e-wallet app: top-up → withdrawal → daily reconciliation; every balance change is booked by the wallet service.

points.text: Concurrency safety (no overdraft): a single conditional UPDATE checks and deducts the balance under a row lock, so concurrent debits queue up and never go negative.
Idempotent APIs: one-time Redis tokens block duplicate submits; a unique index on the business order ID is the final guard.
Lost-callback recovery: verify signature and amount on channel callbacks; scheduled jobs query the channel to recover missed notifications.
Idempotent payouts: freeze funds before payout; on channel timeout only query, never resend; deduct on success, unfreeze on failure.
Eventual consistency: debit and pending notification are written in one DB transaction, then delivered via Kafka with retries (local message table).

jobs.role: Senior Java Backend Engineer — Blockchain Wallet Owner
jobs.context: Global crypto brand — Huobi Wallet team | May 2022 – Apr 2024
jobs.intro: Huobi Wallet: a non-custodial multi-chain wallet with ~12M users (private keys stay on the user's phone). Owned the core flow: wallet creation → on-chain transfer → deposit detection → deposit notification.

points.text: Chain reorgs: detect broken parentHash links, roll back and rescan; credit deposits only after enough confirmations.
OOM fix: the block scanner crashed while catching up; root-caused an unbounded queue holding blocks in memory and switched to a bounded queue with back-pressure.
Reliable delivery + idempotent consumption with Kafka: persist notifications before sending, retry failures, and deduplicate repeated deposit events.
Address filtering with a Bloom filter: discard non-user addresses in each block before hitting the database.
Scanner HA with a Redis distributed lock: one active scanner, automatic failover, resume from the saved cursor.

jobs.context: Major global ride-hailing platform — China's Uber | Oct 2018 – May 2022 | Hangzhou, China
jobs.intro: Ride-hailing platform. Tech lead of the company-wide search service.

points.text: Built the search service from 0 to 1 on Elasticsearch.
Built SQL lineage parsing that automatically extracts upstream/downstream table dependencies, exposed as a query service.
Provided unified query APIs consumed by systems across the company.

jobs.role: Java Backend Engineer — Distributed Job Scheduling
jobs.context: Global e-commerce and cloud technology group | Oct 2016 – Oct 2018 | Hangzhou, China
jobs.intro: Alibaba Group. Core developer of the scheduling system behind Alibaba Cloud DataWorks: master election, job sharding and timed triggers.

points.text: Master HA: nodes compete for a database row lock (SELECT … FOR UPDATE); when the master dies the lock is released and another node takes over automatically.
Job sharding: machines map to a fixed set of logical nodes, so scaling in/out only changes the mapping (similar to consistent hashing).
Quartz-based scheduling of 1M+ hourly/daily/weekly/monthly jobs; average job development time dropped from 36h to 17.45h after launch.

jobs.context: Publicly listed mobile game developer and publisher | Mar 2013 – Oct 2016 | Beijing, China
jobs.intro: Mobile game company listed on the Shenzhen ChiNext board. Built the shared server side used by multiple games: log collection SDK and operations admin.

points.text: Designed and built a server-side game log collection SDK adopted by multiple mobile games.
Developed and maintained the Java operations admin system and its scheduled jobs.

title: Michael C. — Java 后端
description: Java 后端 13 年，阿里、滴滴出身；近几年在火币、dtcpay 做钱包。
name: Michael C.
tagline: Java 后端　·　远程　·　中文、英文

sections.heading: 个人简介
paragraphs: Java 后端 13 年，阿里、滴滴出身；近几年在火币、dtcpay 做钱包。
熟悉 Java / Spring、MySQL、Redis、Kafka 的日常开发与问题排查。
能独立负责一个模块从方案、开发到上线，上手快，配合远程协作。

pairs.text: 需求和决策落成文档，异步协作，会议少而有目的。
以可运行的结果和数据说话，专注把问题解决。
靠代码评审、规范和清晰的职责协作。
技术分歧用事实和数据讨论，信任技术判断。
信息公开，问题当面直说，不走私下渠道。
线程池与 JVM OOM 排查（有界队列）、Spring 事务失效场景
深分页优化（联合索引 + 游标分页）、防超扣（条件更新 + 行锁）
缓存、分布式锁、布隆过滤器
消息可靠投递与幂等消费
钱包创建与交易上链、扫块与到账、链分叉处理
幂等、状态机、渠道对接与对账

jobs.role: Java 后端 Owner（电子钱包）
jobs.context: 新加坡数字支付公司 · 官网：dtcpay.com
jobs.intro: 新加坡 MAS 持牌支付机构（法币 + 稳定币）。C 端 App 电子钱包。负责钱包核心链路：充值到账 → 提现出款 → 每日对账；用户余额的每一笔变动都由钱包服务统一记账。

points.text: ：多笔扣款同时到，行锁让它们排队；每笔用一条更新语句同时判断余额并扣减，余额不够就扣不动，不会扣成负数（条件更新 + 行锁）。
：进支付页先发一次性令牌，提交时 Redis 删掉令牌才处理，连点、重复提交直接挡掉；漏网的靠业务单号兜底，只记一次（唯一索引）。
：渠道通知支付结果时，先验签名、对金额再记账；通知丢了，定时去渠道查单补上。
：先冻结余额再让渠道打款；渠道超时不知道打没打，只去查结果、绝不再发一次，防止给用户打两次钱；查到成功才真扣，查到失败才解冻退回。
：扣款和“待发通知”写在同一个数据库事务里，要么都成、要么都不成；后台再把通知发出去（App 推送、站内信等），失败就重发。不会出现钱扣了、用户却收不到通知（本地消息表 + Kafka）。

jobs.role: Java 后端 Owner（区块链钱包）
jobs.context: 全球加密品牌，Huobi Wallet 钱包团队 · 官网：htx.com
jobs.intro: 火币钱包：去中心化多链钱包，用户约 1200 万，私钥只在用户手机里。负责钱包核心链路：创建钱包 → 转账上链 → 收款到账 → 到账推送。

points.text: ：私钥在手机生成，地址登记到服务端，开始监听这个地址的到账。
：手机用私钥签好交易，发到链上，一直跟踪到交易被确认（广播、pending）。
：新块和上一块接不上，就退回去重新读；这笔交易后面又出了几个块才算到账（parentHash、确认数）。
：扫块落后、加速追赶时进程反复内存溢出，查出是队列没上限把块全堆在内存；改成有上限的队列，满了就等。

points.lead: 可靠投递 + 幂等消费
points.text: ：先把要推的通知存进数据库再发，服务挂了也能补发；同一笔到账只推一次，用户不会收到两条（Kafka）。
：一个块里几千个地址，先筛掉肯定不是我们用户的，剩下的再查库（布隆过滤器）。
：同一时间只让一台扫；它挂了别的接上，从记录的位置继续（Redis 分布式锁）。

jobs.role: 资深 Java 后端（搜索引擎）
jobs.context: 全球大型出行平台，中国网约车代表企业 · 官网：www.didiglobal.com
jobs.intro: 国内网约车平台（中国版 Uber）。负责公司内部统一搜索服务，从搭建到对外提供查询接口。

points.text: ：技术负责人，基于 Elasticsearch 从 0 到 1 搭建搜索服务。
：解析 SQL 语句，自动找出表之间的上下游依赖，做成查询服务。
：为全公司各系统提供统一查询接口。

jobs.role: Java 后端研发（分布式任务调度系统）
jobs.context: 全球电商与云计算科技集团 · 官网：www.alibabagroup.com
jobs.intro: 阿里巴巴集团。参与阿里云 DataWorks 调度系统的核心开发：Master 选主、任务分片与定时触发。

points.text: ：一期 Master / Slave 架构，Master 分配任务、Slave 执行。
：多台机器启动时用数据库抢锁，抢到的当 Master 负责任务规划；Master 挂了锁释放，其余机器重新抢，自动接管（SELECT … FOR UPDATE）。
：机器映射到固定数量的逻辑节点，任务只分给逻辑节点；加减机器只改映射，任务不用重分（类似一致性 hash）。
：基于 Quartz，100 万+ 任务按小时 / 天 / 周 / 月自动执行；平台上线后任务平均开发时长 36 小时 → 17.45 小时。

jobs.role: Java 后端研发（游戏运营后台）
jobs.context: 深交所上市手游研发与发行公司，300315 · 官网：www.ourpalm.com
jobs.intro: A 股创业板上市的手游公司。负责公司多款手游共用的服务端：日志采集 SDK 与运营后台。

points.text: ：游戏日志采集 SDK 架构设计与开发，供公司多款手游接入。
：Java 运营后台与各类定时任务开发维护。

projects.text: 用 AI Agent 独立开发上线的个人主页（Next.js + Vercel） ·

projects.text: 多渠道数据采集：从 BOSS、RemoteOK、V2EX、Telegram、X 等抓取职位汇成一个信息流，自动打标签与评分 ·
